product_reports_resolution_check.name: product_reports_resolution_check
product_reports_resolution_check.value: ("product_reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "product_reports"."resolution" IS NULL) OR ("product_reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "product_reports"."resolution" IN ('hidden', 'kept'))

budgets_dates_check.name: budgets_dates_check
budgets_dates_check.value: CASE WHEN "budgets"."period" = 'custom' THEN "budgets"."starts_on" IS NOT NULL AND "budgets"."ends_on" IS NOT NULL AND "budgets"."starts_on" <= "budgets"."ends_on" ELSE "budgets"."starts_on" IS NULL AND "budgets"."ends_on" IS NULL END

group_order_lines_prices_check.name: group_order_lines_prices_check
group_order_lines_prices_check.value: ("group_order_lines"."manual_price_cents" IS NULL OR "group_order_lines"."manual_price_cents" >= 0) AND ("group_order_lines"."final_price_cents" IS NULL OR "group_order_lines"."final_price_cents" >= 0)

group_order_lines_source_check.name: group_order_lines_source_check
group_order_lines_source_check.value: "group_order_lines"."product_id" IS NOT NULL OR "group_order_lines"."manual_name" IS NOT NULL

items_cents_check.name: items_cents_check
items_cents_check.value: ("items"."price_paid_cents" IS NULL OR "items"."price_paid_cents" >= 0) AND ("items"."sale_price_cents" IS NULL OR "items"."sale_price_cents" >= 0)

wishlists_gift_occasion_check.name: wishlists_gift_occasion_check
wishlists_gift_occasion_check.value: "wishlists"."gift_occasion" IS NULL OR char_length("wishlists"."gift_occasion") BETWEEN 1 AND 320
